ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central region (~85%) contrasted against low-intensity black perimeter and focal spots (~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally dominant contiguous white region occupying the majority of both lobes, bounded by a high-contrast black band along the trailing edge and distal tips. Discrete low-intensity circular focal clusters are distributed asymmetrically, primarily on the medial and left lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a shallow vertical depth relative to the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased complexity and amplitude at the primary distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning toward a linear-to-concave sweep at the outer distal terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately five distinct dark circular pixel clusters on the left lobe and three smaller clusters on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple localized dark focal points consistent with healed pigmentation anomalies; high-contrast white pixel clusters present on the black distal tips indicating localized surface accretion or barnacle colonization.
